description:
Aura is a 90ft Gulf Craft flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering a well-built Gulf Craft with an impeccable finish, four cabins and room for 55 guests.

She welcomes up to 55 guests, has 4 cabins and is run by a professional crew of 4. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for celebrations, corporate outings and large groups, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
